texts: D: ...The river again. Cold water, and someone on the bank, watching.▼
D: Just a dream. Probably.▼
D: I smell toast downstairs. Ron's up early for once.▼
D: Work's at nine. Better get down there before he eats mine.▼
D: RonMorning. You look like you slept in the river.▼
D: RonWork's been dead all week. They cleared out three desks on Friday.▼
D: RonAnd now the boss wants to see us both. First thing. No reason given.▼
D: RonThat's either really good or really bad. My money's on bad.▼
D: RonField office, same as always. Go on, I'll be right behind you.▼
D: RonAnd don't be late. I'm not covering for you again.▼
D: ManagerSit down. Relax, this isn't that conversation.▼
D: ManagerOur field team stopped reporting in. All of them. Two weeks now.▼
D: ManagerTheir last check-in came from Greystone Caverns. Since then, nothing.▼
D: RonSo the desks on Friday... that wasn't layoffs?▼
D: ManagerNo. That was us boxing up their things. Which I'd like to undo.▼
D: ManagerAs of today, you two are field researchers. Congratulations.▼
D: RonIs there a raise in this?▼
D: ManagerThere's a creature in this. Lab's next door. Come on.▼
D: Lab TechThree cradles. Three creatures. Each one's been raised here since it hatched.▼
D: ManagerThey're in the cases with the lights spinning over them. Go and look.▼
D: ManagerPick one. You'll be together a long while, so don't just go by looks.▼
D: RonI'm going by looks.▼
D: Take Tumbloam as your partner?YesNo▼
D: RonThen I'll take this one. It looked at me first.▼
D: Lab TechTumbloam seems to like you. That's a good start.▼
D: ManagerBefore anyone signs anything, a test run.▼
D: ManagerGo out to the tall grass. Catch two wild creatures and log them in the Kilindex.▼
D: ManagerThese crystals are on the company. Hold one up when a creature's worn down.▼
D: ManagerTwo creatures, logged. Then come back here. Don't wander off to Fernwick.▼
D: RonRace you.▼
D: ManagerIt's not a race. ...Fine. It's a race.▼
D: You got 5 dominance crystals.▼
D: Company property. Try to bring some back.▼
